name: Casement
author: Erin Carter
description: A casement window's light thrown across an interior wall: one large bright trapezoid divided by the dark cross of mullion bars into four panes, sheared by projection from a light moving outside. As the source flattens the trapezoid leans and elongates toward a corner, the mullion shadows broaden and their penumbrae melt, then sharpen as it passes head-on — a leading rim of light tracing the edge it lands on first. The whole show is read in negative, looping with no visible reset through a grazing sliver.

params.label: Traverse speed
params.effect: Speed of the outside light's arc, and hence of the trapezoid's glide across the wall.

params.label: Shear range
params.effect: How steeply the projected window leans and stretches at the extremes of the traverse.

params.label: Mullion width
params.effect: CSS-pixel width of the dark mullion bars crossing the lit panes.

params.label: Penumbra
params.effect: How far the mullion and frame edges blur at the flattest incidence of the traverse, from razor at 0 to fully melting at 2.
